topics.name: Reconciliation Blocker Registry
topics.purpose: Define deterministic registry of unresolved blocking findings, affected identities/closure sets, owners and required next actions.

semantics.identity_rule: Each blocker has explicit finding identity.
semantics.owner_rule: Resolution owner/responsible semantic owner is explicit where known.
semantics.ordering_rule: Severity/priority may be explicit but never changes semantic correctness.
semantics.authority_rule: Blocker owner is not automatically runtime administrator.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.
